name: alu
title: 8-bit ALU: AND/OR/XOR/ADD with Cout and Zero flags
description: The capstone composite: bitwise generator lanes, an AdderN<8> arithmetic lane, a Mux4N result select, and an OR-reduction Zero flag with the when/else boundary — most of the language in one artifact.
